create_PowerSGDState: create a PowerSGDState with process_group, matrix_approximation_rank=1, and start_powerSGD_iter=1000 for DDP gradient compression
register_powerSGD_hook: register powerSGD_hook on a DDP model to apply layer-wise low-rank gradient compression during distributed training
register_batched_powerSGD_hook: register batched_powerSGD_hook on a DDP model to apply flattened tensor PowerSGD compression for faster but lower-accuracy gradient compression
test_orthogonalize: test the _orthogonalize function that applies Gram-Schmidt or QR factorization to orthogonalize a batch of matrices
review_should_compress: review the _should_compress function that decides whether a 2D tensor is worth compressing based on min_compression_rate threshold
